Lina (Marketing): Quick ask 0 deliverable mini-pack for the Inference Milestone: benchmark tile, social crops, webinar hero, and 1-page PDF explainer. Need accessible colors + two CTAs for A/B. Deadline Fri EOD.

Marco (Creative Ops): Can you confirm sizes + file types and which CTA variants?

Lina (Marketing): Sizes: LinkedIn 1200x628, X 1600x900, IG 1080x1080, story/mobile 640x360. Webinar 1920x1080. File types: SVG master + PNG@1x/2x + PDF. CTAs: "Try Redwood Inference" (primary) and "Deploy with Redwood" (alt).

June (Design): Will do light/dark/high-contrast versions. Also adding accessible text sizes and alt-text suggestions. Any legal constraints on phrasing?

Nora (Legal): Avoid explicit numeric claims. If you must include numbers, add a footnote with test context. Otherwise use qualitative claims like "lower unit cost" or "reduced latency".

Omar (Product Marketing): Copy options (short):
- "Faster inference. Clearer economics."
- "Serve LLMs reliably, with predictable cost."
- "Latency down, per-token spend down."
Use first option as default and localize EN + DE later.

June (Design): I'll create a single Figma file with components and export presets. I'll include a small two-column callout on the webinar slide: "Dedicated vs Hosted" with icons for routing + cost.

figma-bot: Figma file created: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/inference-milestone-kit 1 components: /bench-tile /social /webinar-slide

Marco (Creative Ops): Timeline: June 48h for first pass, me 24h for QA and exports. I'll produce an export checklist and accessibility screenshots.

Lina (Marketing): Great. Please keep the one-pager footnote editable (legal will review). Prioritize EN social drops.

Omar (Product Marketing): I'll drop final EN copy into Figma today and add a short webinar script to align visuals.

Nora (Legal): I'll review the footnote and final PDF before we publish. If any numeric claims appear, hold distribution until I sign off.

June (Design): Noted. I'll tag localization frames for DE/FR but won't export until we confirm.

Marco (Creative Ops): Kicking off exports when June flags ready. Ping here for scope creep (animations, additional languages). :sparkles:
